svg.title: Dollhouse cutaway: Victorian dollhouse catalogue lithograph
svg.desc: Dollhouse cutaway (2D): the cabin at night, cut open from the front like a plate in a toy catalogue, three floors and every room at once. Your stuffed cat, ringed as the selected toy, stands frozen on the stairs while a sleeping guest's sight cone flickers open across the landing; a dotted path shows where it will walk once the cone closes. The night clock along the top reads two in the morning, and the guest cards on the right are shaded by dread.
svg.text: Plate III. THE CABIN IN SECTION, BY NIGHT. Move while no eye is open.
